name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Malerhäuslhof
beschreibung: The Malerhäuslhof is a farm in Ebbs with holiday apartments for self-catering. The apartments accommodate two to six people and are equipped with a terrace. The farm operates dairy farming and livestock raising, and guests can experience everyday farm life. There is a children's playground and a pond on the grounds. Many excursion destinations in the surrounding mountain landscapes are easily accessible. The nearby Hechtsee can be reached on foot or by car. The quiet location and direct connection to nature characterize the surroundings.
